text:
maya: Quick heads-up — final DB schema migration + backfill is scheduled for 23:00 UTC tonight. Planning to do canary rollout (10% replicas) then full ramp. Need smoke owners for each step and a clear rollback window.

 dylan: I can own the canary deploy + smoke. Will be at my desk 22:45–00:30 UTC.

 aj: I'll take rollback readiness and monitoring dashboards. Where are the smoke queries?

 sophie: Smoke checklist (short):
- run `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated = true LIMIT 1;`
- verify write path to replica
- spot-check recent user reads via unstable accounts

 sophie: Full snippet for the count:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated = true;
```

 maya: @dylan @aj @sophie thanks. We'll follow these windows: canary start 23:00, evaluate 23:10–23:20, ramp to 100% by 23:40 if green. Rollback hold until 00:00 UTC (30m margin).

 deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job `migration-canary-1800456789` at 23:00 UTC. Notifying #eng-oncall.

 jamal: Will run the histogram of write latency at +5m and +15m, posting graphs to thread. If p95 > 200ms, we roll back.

 dylan: Confirmed. I'll run the smoke queries at +2m and +8m. If any failures, abort and call rollback.

 aj: Rollback steps (short):
1) pause writes to new column via feature-flag
2) revert migration job (dbtools rollback migration_2026_03)
3) fail open on read path

 maya: @aj can you pre-stage the rollback command and share exact commands before 22:50?

 aj: Posted the commands to the runbook: `dbtools rollback migration_2026_03 --target canary` and a dry-run flag example.

 sophie: I'll own the smoke dashboard, adding the specific panels now. Will ping when ready.

 maya: thanks — last check: anyone blocked on permissions or infra? If not, we proceed as planned. :thumbsup:

 dylan: all clear from infra.

 jamal: I need access to the replica read role for one more check, granting via IAM now.

 maya: ok, once IAM done, we're good. I'll post a short summary in #general 30m before start.

 sophie: added panels and alert thresholds. I'll post screenshots here at 22:50.

 maya: perfect. If anything changes, update this thread and ping @oncall. GL everyone.
